storyline_updates.title: 2008 credit/banking crisis and recession fears
storyline_updates.note: Market down 41% from its high, 20d return -24.9%, six 2%+ days in the last 10. Headlines are market recaps or commentary with no new cause.

reasoning: Both headlines are recaps or commentary and name no new cause. The regime is the most extreme one: daily realized vol is 5%, six 2%+ days in the last 10, and the market is 41% below its high. Handbook says volatility sizes the move but gives no direction, and direction after big days is a coin flip. The base rate is about 53% up, and the 0.55 confidence threshold is not met. The possible range is wide (about +/-5%) with no edge, so stay flat.
would_change_my_mind: A credible new backstop or policy action (rescue plan, coordinated rate cut) announced before the open, or a clear sign of capitulation, would raise upside confidence above 0.55.
